Keywords: expo sdk 57 react native 0.86 react 19.2 bun
Description: Kaplun targets Expo SDK 57 with RN 0.86 React 19.2 and Bun as package manager.
Do: Keep packages aligned with SDK 57; install natives via bunx expo install / bun expo install.
Don't: Mix SDK majors or hand-pick react-native versions.
Notes: Read https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/ before Expo-specific code.

Keywords: src/app tabs components lib hooks Kaplun structure
Description: Kaplun uses src/app file routes plus shared clay/tw/lib/hooks.
Do: Put screens in src/app/(tabs)/... shared UI in components/clay and src/tw infra in src/lib.
Don't: Dump business logic into route files or invent parallel app/ at root.
Notes: Tab groups: (home) (automate) (messages) (insights) (profile).

Keywords: app.json scheme kaplun plugins userInterfaceStyle light
Description: Kaplun manifest: scheme kaplun orientation portrait userInterfaceStyle light plus Clerk/Router plugins.
Do: Preserve plugins order (expo-secure-store first) and scheme kaplun.
Don't: Flip userInterfaceStyle without checking Clay light-only UI.
Notes: \n    \"userInterfaceStyle\": \"light\"
column13: App currently forces light UI — not automatic.

Description: Public env vars are inlined into the JS bundle — only non-secrets.
Do: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_* for Clerk publishable key Appwrite endpoint/project IG API base IG app id redirect.
Don't: Put private server secrets in EXPO_PUBLIC_ or hardcode them.
Notes: Required: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY APPWRITE_ENDPOINT APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID IG_API_BASE_URL IG_APP_ID IG_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI.

Description: Kaplun auth: Clerk → Gin /auth/appwrite-session → Appwrite session via AuthGate.
Do: Gate data hooks on bridge isReady; use Clerk Bearer only for auth-bridge and automations.
Don't: Call Instagram Graph through a proxy or recreate sessions outside auth-bridge.
Code Example: // AuthGate ensures Appwrite session then mounts <Slot />\n// EXPO_PUBLIC_IG_API_BASE_URL used by auth-bridge + automations only
Notes: bridge_failed ≠ session_expired (Instagram token).

Description: Instagram OAuth uses expo-web-browser openAuthSessionAsync then stores token on creators row.
Do: Keep redirect URI and IG App ID in env; match backend INSTAGRAM_APP_ID.
Don't: Use Facebook App ID instead of Instagram App ID.
Notes: See src/lib/instagram-oauth.ts.

Keywords: Image className tw image not expo-image screens
Description: Screens use @/tw/image (RN Image + useCssElement) for className.
Do: Import Image from @/tw/image in screens/components.
Don't: Import expo-image or RN Image directly in screens for Clay UI.
Code Example: import { Image } from '@/tw/image';\n<Image className='h-12 w-12 rounded-full' source={{ uri }} />
Notes: expo-image is a dependency/plugin but Kaplun screen convention is @/tw/image.

Description: Kaplun EdgeBlur is a LinearGradient scrim — real BlurView crashed Android on transitions.
Do: Use EdgeBlur / LinearGradient for tab scrims; reserve BlurView for proven safe surfaces.
Don't: Drop BlurView onto every screen transition for glass effects.
Code Example: import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';\n// EdgeBlur keeps blurTarget/intensity props for call-site compat only
Notes: Documented anti-pattern in AGENTS.md.

Keywords: reanimated-platform web stub metro alias worklets
Description: Always import Reanimated via @/lib/reanimated-platform; web aliases to stubs.
Do: Add .web.tsx for Reanimated UI; keep metro web aliases.
Don't: Import react-native-reanimated directly in app screens.
Notes: Issue #8285 — worklets crash on web without stubs.

Description: Kaplun uses jest-expo + jest.setup.ts global mocks; run bun test.
Do: Extend transformIgnorePatterns for nativewind/react-native-css/clerk; check jest.setup before new mocks.
Don't: Add duplicate Clerk mocks when __mocks__/@clerk/expo.ts already exists.
Notes: jest.setup.ts is large — read it first.

Keywords: expo-router file-based routing universal deep linking
Description: Expo recommends Expo Router (file-based) over hand-rolled React Navigation for Expo apps.
Do: Use expo-router layouts Stack/Tabs; keep main entry expo-router/entry.
Don't: Introduce a second navigation root beside expo-router.
Notes: Typed routes dynamic routes lazy bundling automatic deep links.

Keywords: app directory index _layout file convention routes
Description: Files under app/ become routes; index is the directory default; _layout wraps children.
Do: Use index.tsx and _layout.tsx; colocate screens by feature group.
Don't: Create folders that are not routes or layouts without intent.
Notes: Kaplun uses src/app (not root app/).

Description: Parentheses groups organize layouts without URL segments.
Do: Use (tabs) and per-tab groups for shared layouts.
Don't: Rely on groups for deep-link path segments users must see.
Notes: Kaplun: (home) (automate) (messages) (insights) (profile).

Description: Dynamic segments use [param].tsx; params are strings.
Do: Type and validate useLocalSearchParams; coerce IDs explicitly.
Don't: Treat params as numbers/objects or store global state in the URL.
Notes: See (automate)/[automationId].tsx.

Description: Stack pushes screens with platform transitions.
Do: Configure options in group _layout or per Screen; hide headers for tab roots when Clay owns chrome.
Don't: Nest unbounded Stacks without hierarchy.
Code Example:
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
<Stack>
  <Stack.Screen name='index' options={{ headerShown: false }} />
</Stack>
Notes: Kaplun tab groups each have a Stack _layout.

Keywords: Tabs tabBar ClayTabBar five tabs screenOptions
Description: Tabs create bottom navigation; Kaplun injects ClayTabBar.
Do: Keep ≤5 tabs; provide icon+label; use tabBar prop for custom bar.
Don't: Add a 6th tab or nest another tab bar inside a tab.
Notes: Clearance via screen-shell constants + EdgeBlur scrim.

Description: Link is declarative navigation to an href.
Do: Use Link for static destinations; asChild to style with Pressable/@/tw.
Don't: Use Link for async/destructive flows that need confirmation first.
Notes: Kaplun also wraps Link in @/tw for className.

Description: Imperative navigation from event handlers and auth redirects.
Do: Call router.push/replace/back inside callbacks; replace for auth gates.
Don't: Call router methods during render.
Notes: Prefer replace for login→app to avoid back-to-auth.

Description: Run effects when a screen gains focus (refetch invalidate).
Do: Wrap callback in useCallback; invalidate React Query keys on focus when needed.
Don't: Omit useCallback (effect re-subscribes every render).
Notes: Complements AppState realtime refetch patterns.

Description: Read current path/segments for analytics or active UI.
Do: Use for highlighting; do not treat as sole navigation state machine.
Don't: Parse groups out manually when helpers already strip them.
Notes: Path typically omits group names.

Keywords: protected routes Expo Router v5 isAuthenticated AuthGate
Description: Router protected routes gate screens on auth; Kaplun uses AuthGate + Slot.
Do: Keep AuthGate as session gate; consider protected routes for finer screen locks.
Don't: Duplicate conflicting auth redirects in every screen.
Code Example: // Kaplun: AuthGate mounts Slot after fonts + bridge\n// Expo Router also supports protected routes in v5+
Notes: See docs/router/advanced/protected.

Keywords: deep link kaplun:// uri-scheme linking into app
Description: Scheme kaplun enables deep links into Expo Router hrefs.
Do: Test with uri-scheme / adb; use Router href shapes.
Don't: Hand-build URLs that ignore Router path conventions.
Notes: Magic-link auth also depends on deep linking.

Description: Use react-native-safe-area-context (comes with Expo Router).
Do: Wrap root with SafeAreaProvider; prefer insets/helpers over ignoring notches.
Don't: Ignore Android edge-to-edge overlaps.
Code Example: import { SafeAreaProvider, useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';\nconst insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
Notes: Kaplun root _layout already uses SafeAreaProvider; also NativeWind p-safe / screen-shell.

Description: Customize status bar (all) and Android navigation bar.
Do: Match StatusBar style to canvas contrast; use navigation-bar plugin for Android.
Don't: Assume translucent bars without safe-area padding on Android 15+.
Notes: Kaplun app.json sets expo-navigation-bar style light.

Description: Load Inter via expo-font; prefer static OTF/TTF; variable fonts incomplete.
Do: Gate UI on useClayFonts(); match PostScript names; prefer OTF.
Don't: Render text before fonts load or use variable font files.
Code Example: import { useClayFonts } from '@/lib/fonts';\nconst loaded = useClayFonts();\nif (!loaded) return null;
Notes: Config plugin embeds fonts for prod; useFonts works with Expo Go.

Description: Configure splash via plugin; icons must be square PNG; Android adaptive layers.
Do: Test splash on preview/production builds not Expo Go; use 1024 PNG.
Don't: Test splash only in Expo Go/dev-client (own splash interferes).
Notes: iOS may cache launch screens — run:ios --no-build-cache when stuck.

Keywords: userInterfaceStyle automatic light dark useColorScheme expo-system-ui
Description: Appearance follows userInterfaceStyle; Android needs expo-system-ui for the setting to apply.
Do: Install expo-system-ui for Android; detect with useColorScheme.
Don't: Expect dark mode while Kaplun forces light without updating Clay tokens.
Code Example: // Kaplun app.json currently: userInterfaceStyle: 'light'\n// For system: 'automatic' + expo-system-ui
Notes: Absent property defaults to light.

Description: Prefer Reanimated for performant animations; Animated API is built-in fallback.
Do: Import via Kaplun reanimated-platform; keep transforms/opacity.
Don't: Animate layout width/height heavily or import reanimated raw on web.
Notes: Default Expo template already includes Reanimated.

Keywords: expo-secure-store tokens keychain keystore small values
Description: Encrypt small secrets (tokens keys) on device.
Do: Use SecureStore for credentials; Clerk tokenCache uses it.
Don't: Store large blobs or non-secrets in SecureStore.
Code Example: import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';\nawait SecureStore.setItemAsync('key', value);
Notes: First plugin in Kaplun app.json.

Keywords: AsyncStorage unencrypted preferences React Query persist

Don't: Put Instagram/Clerk secrets in AsyncStorage.

Notes: See Store data guide alternatives: SQLite FileSystem.

Description: Read resolved app config at runtime.
Do: Use Constants.expoConfig for scheme/version feature flags.
Don't: Store secrets in Constants.
Notes: Useful with app.config dynamic values.

Description: Open external URLs and build deep links.
Do: Use Linking.openURL for browser/store; Router for in-app.
Don't: Use Linking for in-app screen navigation.
Notes: Pairs with scheme kaplun.

Description: Tactile feedback for presses and confirmations.
Do: Use light impact on primary taps; respect reduce-motion/haptics settings.
Don't: Fire haptics on every scroll tick.
Notes: Installed in Kaplun package.json.

Description: Gradients for backgrounds and EdgeBlur scrims.
Do: Use for Clay atmosphere and tab-edge fades.
Don't: Use gradients as the only accessibility cue for text contrast.
Notes: EdgeBlur implementation.

Description: In-app browser auth sessions for OAuth.
Do: Prefer openAuthSessionAsync for OAuth redirect loops.
Don't: Use a raw WebView for Meta OAuth without session helpers.
Notes: Kaplun Instagram OAuth path.

Description: Higher-level OAuth helpers (providers discovery PKCE).
Do: Use when building custom OAuth beyond WebBrowser open.
Don't: Bypass PKCE for public mobile clients.
Notes: Kaplun IG flow currently uses web-browser + manual URL; package present.

Keywords: npx expo install bun expo install SDK aligned
Description: expo install picks SDK-compatible native module versions.

Keywords: expo-dev-client development build vs Expo Go native modules
Description: Dev build = your Expo Go with custom native code via expo-dev-client.

Don't: Assume Expo Go covers all Kaplun native deps forever.
Code Example: bun expo install expo-dev-client\nbunx expo run:android\n# or: eas build --profile development --platform android
Notes: Rebuild after native deps app.json changes or SDK bumps (prebuild --clean).

Keywords: prebuild --clean native modules app.json SDK upgrade
Description: JS-only changes need expo start; native/config/SDK changes need regenerate+rebuild.
Do: Run prebuild --clean then run:android|ios / EAS after native changes.
Don't: Keep hand-edited android/ios forever without CNG discipline.
Notes: ios/android are gitignored in Kaplun — CNG style.

Description: Plugins modify native projects during prebuild.
Do: Add official plugins to app.json plugins array; pass options as tuple.
Don't: Edit generated native projects for things a plugin already covers.
Notes: Kaplun plugins: secure-store Clerk router web-browser font system-ui status-bar navigation-bar image.

Description: Present screens as modal/sheet via Stack options.
